content.text:
The visible suite now passes. The fix is in `solution/core.py`.

The cause was that `_expired` used `>`, so an entry only expired after its TTL had fully passed. It should expire at exactly the TTL, so I changed it to `>=`.

I also made two related changes that the visible test doesn't cover:
- `put` now purges expired entries before checking capacity. Before, it could evict a live least-recently-used entry while expired ones were still stored.
- `__len__` now purges expired entries before counting, so it no longer counts them.

result:
The visible suite now passes. The fix is in `solution/core.py`.

The cause was that `_expired` used `>`, so an entry only expired after its TTL had fully passed. It should expire at exactly the TTL, so I changed it to `>=`.

I also made two related changes that the visible test doesn't cover:
- `put` now purges expired entries before checking capacity. Before, it could evict a live least-recently-used entry while expired ones were still stored.
- `__len__` now purges expired entries before counting, so it no longer counts them.
